items.original_title: Dems More Motivated to Turn Out in Midterms Than Trump Base, Says Eli Yokley
items.rss_summary: Eli Yokley, politics analyst for Morning Consult, said that race ratings are turning away from Republicans because Democrats are more motivated to turn out to vote in the upcoming midterm elections than the Trump base. Yokley said Trump's approval rating has declined significantly in key states like Alaska and Kansas as war with Iran drags on.  (Source: Bloomberg)
